department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.quote: Fall application deadlines for ECE graduate programs are as follows: | PhD Applicants | December 5

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required and strongly discouraged.
gre_general.quote: *GRE scores are not required for our program. Submitting GRE scores will not improve your chances of admission. We strongly discourage applicants from submitting GRE scores, as scores that fall below university minimums will negatively impact your application.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no Electrical and Computer Engineering subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Pre-application faculty contact is not required.

funding.value: Funded PhD applicants are automatically considered for departmental assistantships and fellowships.
funding.quote: Most entering graduate students are initially supported by a teaching assistantship, which pays the student’s tuition and provides a stipend.

entry_route.value: Direct admission from bachelor's degree with upper-division GPA of at least 3.0.
entry_route.quote: For applicants with solely a bachelor’s degree, a minimum 3.0 GPA on all coursework completed after the applicant has earned 60 semester hours (90 quarter hours) is required.

english_waiver.value: ECE department does not waive English test requirement based on medium of instruction.
english_waiver.quote: The ECE department will not waive the English language test score requirement based on medium of instruction
